about:
# LibAboutPanel-2.0

LibAboutPanel-2.0 is a World of Warcraft Lua library for displaying addon metadata in Blizzard's Settings UI or as an AceConfig-3.0-compatible options table. It works with all valid WoW clients.

## Requirements

- Required: LibStub
- Optional: AceConfig-3.0, if using `:AboutOptionsTable()`

## Quick Usage

For Ace3 addons, embed LibAboutPanel-2.0 when creating your addon object:

```lua
local MyAddon = LibStub("AceAddon-3.0"):NewAddon("MyAddon", "LibAboutPanel-2.0")
```

For non-Ace3 addons, embed the library into your addon object:

```lua
LibStub("LibAboutPanel-2.0"):Embed(MyAddon)
```

Or use it directly:

```lua
local LAP = LibStub("LibAboutPanel-2.0")
```

Create a Blizzard Settings About panel:

```lua
MyAddon:CreateAboutPanel("MyAddon")
-- or
LAP:CreateAboutPanel("MyAddon")
```

Create an AceConfig-3.0-compatible About options table:

```lua
options.args.about = MyAddon:AboutOptionsTable("MyAddon")
```

`AboutOptionsTable()` only returns the table. Your addon is responsible for registering it with AceConfig-3.0 or embedding it in an existing options table.

## Documentation

See [WIKI.md](https://github.com/Myrroddin/libaboutpanel-2.0/blob/master/WIKI.md) for:

- `.pkgmeta` integration
- Ace3 example usage
- API reference
- Supported `.toc` fields
- Category and localization notes
- Troubleshooting

## Contributing

- Help translate or verify localization [at CurseForge](https://legacy.curseforge.com/wow/addons/libaboutpanel-2-0/localization)
- Report bugs or request improvements via the [GitHub issue tracker](https://github.com/Myrroddin/libaboutpanel-2.0/issues)

## [1.0.91](https://github.com/Myrroddin/libaboutpanel-2.0/tree/1.0.91) (2026-10-31)
[Full Changelog](https://github.com/Myrroddin/libaboutpanel-2.0/compare/1.0.90...1.0.91) [Previous Releases](https://github.com/Myrroddin/libaboutpanel-2.0/releases)

- [All] Change a Russian translation to be more natural  
- Merge pull request #3 from Langmans/fix/locale-true-values  
    [All] Treat a translation set to true as its key, fixes issue #2 on GitHub.  
- [All] Write out the translations that were true  
    deDE and itIT Repository, esES, frFR and itIT Copyright, frFR Date now carry their text instead of true, so each locale reads like the others; the shim's \_\_newindex stays as a guard.  
    Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>  
- [All] Treat a translation set to true as its key  
    Some inline translations are `true` (deDE Repository, esES Copyright, frFR  
    Copyright and Date, itIT Copyright and Repository). The shim stored the  
    boolean, so GetVersion's gsub and GetLicense's concatenation raised errors on  
    those clients for any addon with a Version or X-License. A \_\_newindex now  
    stores the key for `true`, as AceLocale does.  
    Fixes #2  
    Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
